name: My Friend of AnotherWorld
source:
A young woman who has endured many losses in her life moves to a small town and must confront the ghosts of her past before it is too late.

In this adventure, your avatar finds themselves in a world where ghosts and spirits are always nearby. Your mission is to survive and help everyone you can.

[Translated from [url=https://estudiosmlv.itch.io/my-friend-of-anotherworld]Itch.io[/url]]
